name: smoke
description: Single-user single-shot pipeline check: one VU, one iteration — verifies script, data, contract and wiring end to end. A link test, not a load test. Mandatory in the same session before any big round (doubles as the live check that static data is still valid). Need a few more samples ad hoc? Override with ITERATIONS=5 VUS=1.
_apiSla: Exempt on purpose: a percentile over 1-2 cold samples is statistically void (sample-size doctrine) — a first-hit >SLA would fail the run and block the smoke gate for no reason. Smoke's verdict = three-class cleanliness only; latency judgment starts with baseline/load rounds. SLA keys are still existence-checked, so a misconfigured key fails fast.
